hooks.command: _o=$(if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'catalog.json'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "catalog.json is product data. Do not modify without explicit instruction from Ciamac. Data changes go through Jeremy after Luiz approval."}'; fi); _r=$?; _oc="allowed"; echo "$_o" | grep -q '"decision"' && _oc="blocked"; ~/.claude/scripts/hook-logger.sh "PreToolUse" "FileEdit:catalog" "$_oc" "${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-unknown}" 2>/dev/null; printf '%s' "$_o"; exit $_r

_o=$(if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'vite.config'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "vite.config.js is frozen. Do not modify."}'; fi); _r=$?; _oc="allowed"; echo "$_o" | grep -q '"decision"' && _oc="blocked"; ~/.claude/scripts/hook-logger.sh "PreToolUse" "FileEdit:viteconfig" "$_oc" "${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-unknown}" 2>/dev/null; printf '%s' "$_o"; exit $_r

_o=$(if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'src/'; then echo '{"additionalContext": "Source file was modified. Run constraint validation suite (npm test) before committing."}'; fi); _r=$?; _oc="allowed"; [ -n "$_o" ] && _oc="warned"; ~/.claude/scripts/hook-logger.sh "PostToolUse" "FileEdit:src" "$_oc" "${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-unknown}" 2>/dev/null; printf '%s' "$_o"; exit $_r

_o=$(if [ -f SESSION_STATE.md ]; then echo '{"additionalContext": "SESSION_STATE.md exists. Read it for tactical handoff."}'; fi); _r=$?; _oc="allowed"; [ -n "$_o" ] && _oc="warned"; ~/.claude/scripts/hook-logger.sh "SessionStart" "SessionStart" "$_oc" "SESSION_STATE.md" 2>/dev/null; printf '%s' "$_o"; exit $_r
